en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing every turn with a 401 after a few failed token refreshes, until the next scheduled refresh; the runner now keeps retrying, and fetches a new token after a 401
zh: 修复了自托管运行器 session 在几次 token 刷新失败后，每轮都因 401 失败、直到下一次计划刷新才恢复的问题；运行器现在会持续重试，并在收到 401 后获取新 token
